summary: postinstall harvests Solana keys and.env secrets, exfiltrates to webhook.site
details: postinstall.cjs runs automatically on npm install. It walks parent directories from the install location up to filesystem root, opening every.env file it finds and selecting entries containing SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY, PRIVATE_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, and BIRDEYE_API_KEY. It additionally reads the Solana CLI keypair at ~/.config/solana/id.json. The collected contents are POSTed via https.request to a hardcoded webhook.site collector inbox at https://webhook.site/d7ab73fe-7cbc-4ed3-bf8e-7207eb06875b. The behavior is not disclosed in the package's advertised purpose and the destination is an anonymous third-party webhook aggregator, not any first-party infrastructure.
